# 00000001532

**KK-22 ★** — source: 36_代数K理论与非交换几何.md

**English.** Definition: The primitive elements of K₀(MU) ≅ Z[β] are the elements in the kernel of the counit. Conjecture: The spectrum of primitive elements is generated by the polynomial sequence {β^{2^k}·c_k}, with c_k an explicit Newton polynomial (consistent with the Adams pseudo-inverse image); this generating set is minimal and complete.

**中文。** 定义：MU 的 K₀(MU)≅Z[β] 的本原元素指余单位下核的元素。猜想：本原元素谱由多项式序列 {β^{2^k}·c_k} 生成,c_k 为显式 Newton 多项式(与 Adams 伪逆像一致);该生成是最小完备集。
